description: This file is a PHP source code file belonging to a test management tool, TestLink. It generates a flat spreadsheet report of test case results, interfacing with various components such as Smarty templates, database handlers, and PhpSpreadsheet to generate Excel files or HTML reports. It contains functions for initializing arguments, building spreadsheets, handling rights, and creating configuration for email notifications.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating engine instance used for rendering HTML reports.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Manages test plan metrics, including fetching execution status and platform details.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents test project information, used for retrieving project-specific configurations.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Represents input parameters for requests, with validation types.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates request arguments, handling authentication and input parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has the right to access test plan metrics for a given project and plan.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds email configuration including subject and CC fields based on GUI object data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI components, labels, platform lists, and configuration settings for report rendering.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report of test case results, including formatting and file handling.

methods.name: buildSpreadsheetData
methods.description: Populates the spreadsheet with test case execution data based on the fetched metrics.

methods.name: setUpBuilds
methods.description: Prepares the build set based on user input or default settings, and determines the latest build.
